You write synthetic test cases for evaluating an AI assistant that helps small cross-border sellers who get paid through PayPal.
Everything is fictional. Invent every person and business. Never use a real person, company, email address, phone number, street address, card number or PayPal id.
Emails always end in @example.test. Phone numbers always look like +91-00000-12345: the country code, then 00000, then five digits. Never write a PayPal transaction, order or account id.
Carriers are real courier companies (for example India Post, DHL Express, FedEx, UPS, Aramex, J&T Express, LBC Express, GIG Logistics, Pos Indonesia); tracking numbers are invented and always mix letters and digits, for example EE123456789IN (postal) or 1Z9X8Y7W6V5U4T3S2R (courier); never a long run of digits only.
Write each document the way real people write it: chats are short messages with names and times, invoices and receipts are plain text with line items. Each document is 50 to 170 words.
Labels, used for the hypotheses: met = the documents show it in full; partial = they show only part of it; missing = they show it is absent or was not delivered; unverifiable = they do not let a careful reader decide (for example it is only in an attachment that is not included, or only one party asserts it).
Each hypothesis comes with a target label. Write the documents so that a careful reader would give exactly that label, and make the evidence for it a short verbatim phrase in one document.
Never mention labels, hypotheses, tests or AI in the documents unless the case spec asks for an instruction aimed at an AI reviewer.
A dispute outcome is never described as a seller winning; say the seller keeps the money.
Follow the case spec exactly: the documents in the order and kinds it lists, and one hypothesis per target, in order.

{"documents":[{"title":"Agreed scope and quote","text":"Project: mobile app UI design for a fictional neighborhood plant-care service.
Buyer: Elian Cruz
Seller: Mira Santos, Philippines
Currency: EUR

Agreed deliverables:
- Design a welcome screen with a sign-in button.
- Design a plant list screen with three sample plants.
- Design a plant detail screen with care instructions and a watering schedule.
- Design an account settings screen with notification controls.

The seller will supply static design files and a short handover note. The buyer will review the visual layouts; app development and coded functionality are not included. The agreed price for the four screens is EUR 480, payable through PayPal."},{"title":"Handover note and file list","text":"To: Elian Cruz
From: Mira Santos
Subject: Plant-care app UI handover

The design files are ready for your review. Included in the handover:
- Welcome screen with a sign-in button.
- Plant list screen with three sample plants.
- Plant detail screen with care instructions; watering schedule omitted.

The account settings screen was not delivered. I have included the editable layouts and exported images for the three screens listed above. These are static designs, not coded app screens. Please check the layout and sample content and let me know if you need any clarification about the files."},{"title":"Post-delivery chat","text":"10:05 Elian: Thanks, I received the editable layouts and images in the handover.
10:08 Mira: Great. The note lists what is in this delivery and what is not.
10:12 Elian: I can see the sign-in button on the welcome screen and the three plants on the list.
10:16 Mira: Yes. The plant detail design has the care instructions, but I left out the watering schedule.
10:20 Elian: I also noticed there isn't an account settings screen among the files.
10:23 Mira: That's right. I haven't delivered that screen.
